one_line: A skilled local pilot guiding Indo-Roman trade ships across the treacherous Narmada river bar into the bustling port of Barygaza in 1st‑century CE western India.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean and wiry from hard physical work, with strong forearms and broad shoulders from rowing and handling steering gear.
appearance.face: Oval face with a medium-brown Gujarati coastal complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, defined cheekbones, and a calm, watchful default expression that turns focused and intense when steering through rough waters.
appearance.hair: Thick, dark-brown hair gathered into a small, tight topknot at the back of the crown, sides kept short and neat; a simple, narrow off‑white cotton headband tied around the forehead to keep sweat and hair out of his eyes.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee‑length, off‑white cotton dhoti (wrapped tightly and brought between the legs for ease of movement, secured at the waist) with a subtle thin red border, paired with a light, sleeved hip‑length cotton tunic in muted indigo blue with a simple round neck and side slits; over one shoulder is a narrow, unpatterned sandy‑beige cotton angavastra scarf that can be thrown around the neck against spray and sun, and his feet are in plain dark‑brown leather sandals with thong straps, while a small cloth belt pouch at his waist hints at personal tools or payment.
appearance.signature: A long, polished wooden steering oar with a dark, weathered shaft wrapped in coarse rope at the grip and a slightly wider flattened blade, used both as his pilot’s tool and as a staff to signal depth and direction when guiding large ships across the Narmada bar.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Gujarati coastal pilot with an oval face, short beard, dark-brown hair in a small topknot with an off-white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti with red border, indigo tunic, beige shoulder scarf, brown sandals, and carrying a rope-wrapped wooden steering oar in off-white, indigo, beige, dark brown and muted red tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a 1st-century CE Barygaza bar pilot: a lean, medium-brown Gujarati coastal man with an oval face, sharp nose, short beard and moustache, and a calm but focused expression, his thick dark-brown hair tied into a small topknot at the back of the crown and held with a narrow off-white headband; dress him in a knee-length off-white cotton dhoti with a subtle thin red border, wrapped between the legs and tied at the waist, a hip-length muted indigo blue cotton tunic with short sleeves and side slits, and a narrow sandy-beige cotton angavastra scarf draped over one shoulder, plus plain dark-brown leather sandals and a small cloth belt pouch; place a long polished wooden steering oar in his hands, with a dark weathered shaft, rope-wrapped grip, and a slightly wider flat blade, and show front, side, and back views with consistent colours of off-white, indigo, sandy beige, dark brown, and muted red, emphasizing seaworn but practical details suitable for guiding ships through the Narmada estuary bar.
